key_idea: Layered shortest path: dp over tiles of value v from all tiles of value v-1 with Manhattan cost.
sketch: Group tile coordinates by number, set dp=0 on all 1-tiles and relax level by level trying every pair of tiles in consecutive levels. The sum of products of consecutive level sizes is at most (n^2)^2/4 ~ 1.6M, so the plain double loop is fast. Print -1 if some number in 1..k is missing (the level's dp stays infinite). k=1 gives 0 when a 1-tile exists.
